tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Micron 8GB 1Rx4 PC4-2133P-RC0-10 ECC REG Server Memory (MTA18ASF1G72PZ-2G1A2II) – High-Performance, Reliable Memory for Enterprise Servers


Enhance your server's performance with Micron 8GB 1Rx4 PC4-2133P-RC0-10 ECC REG Server Memory, designed for enterprise-level applications, virtualization, and data center environments. Featuring Error-Correcting Code (ECC), this memory module provides superior data integrity, reducing the risk of system crashes and data corruption. It’s engineered to deliver reliability and stability under heavy workloads, making it ideal for mission-critical servers, databases, and high-performance applications.

The Micron MTA18ASF1G72PZ-2G1A2II memory module operates at PC4-2133P speeds, ensuring fast data processing and efficient system performance. With 1Rx4 configuration and Registered DIMM (RDIMM) architecture, this memory is optimized for multi-processor server environments, offering scalability and smooth performance in demanding IT infrastructures.

Key Features:

8GB capacity for enhanced multitasking and faster data handling in servers
1Rx4 configuration for increased bandwidth and efficient data flow
PC4-2133P speed for fast and reliable server performance
ECC (Error-Correcting Code) support to minimize data corruption and system errors
Registered DIMM (RDIMM) for improved scalability and stability in multi-processor setups
Compatible with leading server brands like Dell, HP, and Lenovo

Ideal for virtualization, cloud computing, and enterprise databases
